svg.text: Phase 2 · step 8e · Photos (and where PDFs will sit): two options
Where photos and PDFs show on an event, a task, a squawk, and a vehicle; adding them (Take photo, Choose, the size); and looking at one. PDFs open in the viewer in 8f.
A · A strip of thumbnails under each thing, with + Add at the end; tap one to see it
Wide · a repair draft in the work log, and a squawk
The task's own: e.g. the worn pads, the receipt. The job's (not a task's) sit below the tasks.
Saved with the draft. Once it's finished, they're locked; a correction starts with them.
Rattle from the rear on bumps
Anyone who may change the squawk adds photos, any time (even after a job dealt with it).
A vehicle's Overview: its photos the same way (an Admin adds them); the first is its picture.
Phone · a fuel-up, adding a photo
+ Photos are where the thing is:
on the task, the squawk, the job.
− Names and sizes show only when
B · A list under each thing: a small thumbnail, the name, and its details; + Photo and + PDF buttons
Picked photos join the list with a size menu each, then upload.
Both · Looking at a photo: it fills the screen; its details, Download, and Remove below
← → (or swipe on a phone) for the next one. PDFs open the same way, in the pdf.js viewer (8f).
A photo's place comes from its GPS (looked up like an event's) and is never shown in exports by default (#036). The JPEG itself carries no metadata.
